note: Spelling differs from the engraving: Dickinson prints 'Alphei', Procter & Wordsworth's breviary kalendar prints 'Alphegi archiepiscopi et martyris' on the same day (xiii Kal. Maii, letter d). 'elfe' is the vernacular form of the same name (Old English Aelfheah, Middle English Elphege/Elfege); this is a spelling, not a different feast.
